_question: Round-3/4 reviewer ask: confidence interval and hypothesis test on the Pytea modern-subset (N=34) head-to-head.  Round-5 ships this as the round's reviewer-not-mentioned improvement.
interpretation: McNemar's exact two-sided p = 0.001953 on b=10, c=0, chi^2 (Yates) = 8.10 on 1 df, p = 0.004427.  Paired bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed=7) 95% CI on (TG - Pytea) refute-rate difference is [0.147, 0.441] with point estimate 0.294.  Lower bound > 0 corroborates the head-to-head gap.
